title: OpenAI Releases Decisions API in Public Beta, Powered by GPT-6 Luna
key_facts: OpenAI released the Decisions API in public beta on 6 Oct 2026, via a POST /v1/decisions endpoint using gpt-6-luna.
It returns typed answers (yes-no probability, one choice from a set, or a score) to developer-defined questions about text and images.
OpenAI says it is about 10x faster than the Responses API.
Pricing is $0.10 per 1M input tokens, with only input tokens billed.
It supports Zero Data Retention and HIPAA for eligible customers, with US and European data residency.
It followed a limited preview at DevDay 2026; general availability is expected in the coming weeks.
GPT-6 Luna launched with GPT-6 Sol on 22 Sep 2026.
